Exclusive OR means one is true and the other is false, while 'if and only if' means both have the same truth value. Specifically, the NL should have been paired with `∀x (p_3(x) ↔ ¬p_11(x))` to correctly represent 'if and only if', or the NL should have been 'For all x, either x remained humble or x did not leave a lasting legacy, but not both' to match the XOR. The current mapping is incorrect due to the operator difference and the missing negation in the FOL's second operand if it were to correctly represent the NL's second part.
